answer: Give every key its own island of data. Each epoch the beacon seed plus the key's address generates a private ledger of 40 trades that only that key is shown, and its answer must quote one derived fact, like which cedar crate of marble sold highest. Graders recheck that fact in a second from the same seed. A 1,000-key farm can't reuse one good answer: it must read 1,000 different ledgers and reason 1,000 times. Two wrong facts in 10 epochs freeze that key's pay for 20 epochs.
